findings.title: Historical replies can settle requests that had not yet been written

locations.reason: Records messages_seen_before_write, but accepts drain return and first matching historical frame with no own-write lower bound.
Capture.drain searches all self.messages after each select; an already observed future ID can be returned without new stdout.
Final validate_frames compares final typed ID set/cardinality, not per-write chronology.
Required request->response chronology and failure semantics are stronger than the implemented check.

findings.counterexample: After only initialize is written, one stdout read contains init plus all12 exact typed positive results plus barrier. Keep peer open to consume subsequent stdin writes and exit0 on EOF, with no further responses. At later sends messages_seen_before_write=14; Capture.drain returns each cached matching frame after select. The new driver predicts success,14 settlements and clean final unique-ID validation although13 results preceded their own requests. This is a source-derived data trace, not an executed target or helper.
findings.why_existing_next_write_check_is_insuffi: For every row, response_frame_index is less than messages_seen_before_next_write (or14 atEOF), and response types/order are exact. The Lead-described reader is outside the R1 freeze and was not inspected; the described upper bound alone does not exclude this trace.
required_grouped_rework: Keep sealed Capture, guard, parent and all23 case objects unchanged; repair only the new lane under Lead ownership and freeze replacements for R2.

Enforce request->response->nextrequest precedence, including the lower bound at the request's own actual write/flush. A response already observed before its request must fail, never become a settlement.

After drain, inspect newly observed frames against the currently sent/pending typed IDs and reject early future-source/control replies before proceeding. Keep unchanged validate_frames for final missing/late/duplicate/error-envelope checks.

Require independent post-data reconstruction to check both own-write lower bound and next-write/EOF upper bound, typed identity, delivered writes and14settlements. Preserve raw evidence and first failure; do not normalize.

Add pure-data ordering controls for early future source response, early barrier, and valid post-write response with interleaved notification. These controls remain data-only and do not spend or prove runtime IO.
